questions.title: fadeOut() with a callback
questions.prompt: When the **Dismiss** button inside `#banner` is clicked, fade the banner out over **200 ms**, and **after** the fade finishes (in a callback function) remove the banner from the page.

setup.html:
Free shipping this week!

Page content.
setup.css:
body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }
#banner { background: #fff3a0; padding: .5em; }

hints: remove() takes an element out of the DOM.

tests.name: Still on the page right after the click

questions.title: slideToggle() a panel
questions.prompt: The `#panel` starts hidden (CSS). Clicking `#toggle` should slide the panel down or up with `slideToggle()` over **150 ms**, and change the button text to `Hide details` or `Show details` to match.

setup.html: Details about the product.
setup.css:
body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }
#panel { display: none; background: #eef; padding: .5em; }

hints: Check $("#panel").is(":visible") before toggling, or use the callback.

questions.title: animate() basics
questions.prompt: When `#go` is clicked, use `animate()` to move `#box` so its `left` is `200px` and its `opacity` is `0.5`, over **200 ms**.

tests.name: Moving partway at 100 ms

questions.title: Chain animations
questions.prompt: Clicking `#grow` should **chain** two `animate()` calls on `#bar`: first animate its `width` to `300px` (150 ms), **then** its `height` to `60px` (150 ms). Chained animations run one after another.

setup.css:
body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }
#bar { width: 50px; height: 20px; background: #27ae60; }

questions.title: delay() between effects
questions.prompt: When `#save` is clicked, make `#msg` (hidden by CSS) **fade in** over 100 ms, **wait 300 ms** using `delay()`, then **fade out** over 100 ms — all in one chain.

setup.css:
body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }
#msg { display: none; color: #27ae60; }

tests.name: The message is visible during the delay

questions.title: stop() an animation
questions.prompt: `#start` animates `#box` to `left: 400px` over **2000 ms**. `#stop` must **stop** the animation right where it is with `stop()`.

tests.name: Stop leaves the box partway

questions.title: finish() an animation
questions.prompt: `#start` fades `#note` to opacity `0.2` over **2000 ms** and then slides it up. `#finish` must jump straight to the **end of all queued animations** using `finish()`.

setup.html: A note that will fade and slide away.
setup.css:
body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }
#note { background: #eef; padding: .5em; }

hints: finish() completes the current and queued animations immediately; stop() only halts the current one.

tests.name: Finish jumps to the end state

questions.title: Easings
questions.prompt: Animate `#ball` to `left: 300px` over **400 ms** using the **linear** easing (jQuery's default easing is `swing`). Start the animation when the page loads.

tests.name: Moves at a steady speed (about halfway at 200 ms)

questions.title: Slide show with fades
questions.prompt: Clicking `#next` should **fade out** `#slide` (100 ms), then — in the callback — change its `src` to the next image in `images` (wrapping around) and **fade it back in** (100 ms). Update `#caption` to `Slide 2 of 3` etc. at the same time as the src.

setup.html: Slide 1 of 3
setup.css: body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 1em; }

tests.name: Wraps from slide 3 to slide 1

questions.title: Carousel with animate()
questions.prompt: Like the chapter's Carousel application: `#strip` holds four 100px-wide items inside a 100px-wide window. Clicking `#right` animates `#strip`'s `left` **100px further left** (150 ms) to show the next item; at the last item it animates back to `left: 0`. Ignore clicks while an animation is running (check `:animated`).
hints: Read the current position with parseInt($("#strip").css("left")).

tests.name: A click during the animation is ignored
After the last item it returns to 0
